copy.description_500c:
Dataflare is open-source product analytics that runs in your own Cloudflare account. `npx dataflare-cli init` deploys a Worker, a D1 database and an R2 bucket for session replays, then prints the snippet for your framework. It covers web analytics, custom events, funnels, retention, session replay, feature flags and A/B tests.

It is built for coding agents: init writes agent instructions, a skill and an MCP server config, and every query result carries its SQL. There is no subscription. Cloudflare bills you at its list prices, and small sites fit the Workers free plan.
copy.awesome_list_bullet: - [Dataflare](https://github.com/ISNIT0/glass-analytics) - Open-source product analytics (web, funnels, retention, session replay, flags, A/B tests) that deploys into your own Cloudflare account, with an MCP server for coding agents.
key_features: One command (`npx dataflare-cli init`) deploys a Worker, D1 database and R2 replay bucket into your Cloudflare account
Web analytics, custom events, funnels, retention, session replay, feature flags and A/B tests in one dashboard
MCP server, CLI with --json and an HTTP API; every result carries its SQL
Cookieless mode that stores nothing on the device and never stores IP addresses

taxonomy.pricing_model: Free and open source (MIT); Cloudflare usage billed by Cloudflare
taxonomy.free_tier_details: No Dataflare plan or fee. Small sites fit Cloudflare's Workers free plan; larger ones pay Cloudflare list prices (calculator at /pricing/).
